sulfated_ash.calculation_note: Sulfated ash = (Ca_ppm×3.40 + Mg_ppm×4.95 + Zn_ppm×1.24)/10000; elements are in wt.% here, so = 3.40×3.15 (Ca) + 1.24×1.24 (Zn) = 12.2476 → 12.25 wt.%. Mg not reported, taken as 0.

open_questions: The two TDS (DL2-13819.pdf 'TDS OF RF6066' and DL2-15451.pdf) carry no date, so the order of revisions cannot be determined. Density, KV100, TBN, Zn and Ca differ between documents (see conflicts) and are left null. DL2-13819.pdf matches the 2020 SDS (density 990, TBN 106); DL2-15451.pdf matches the 2021 SDS (density 0.988, 185 mm²/s), which suggests DL2-15451.pdf is the later TDS, but no date is printed.
Supplier spelled 'Xinxiang Richuful Lube Additive Co. Ltd.' in SDS DL2-13820.pdf p.1 and 'Xinxiang Richful Lube Additive Co., Ltd.' in SDS DL2-15831.pdf p.1.
DL2-15831.pdf (SDS 2021): body text is image/vector graphics; read visually from page renders.
Old Product_JSON mixed values from DL2-15451.pdf and DL2-13819.pdf without flagging the differences.

Component shares (not element contents): SDS DL2-15831.pdf p.2: base-oil distillates 10 - 39.9 %; ZDDP (68649-42-3) 3 - 17.9 %; overbased calcium sulfurized phenate 1 - 14.9 %; alkylated diphenylamine 0.5 - 9.9 %; molybdenum dithiocarbamate 0.1 – 1.99 %. SDS DL2-13820.pdf p.2 lists ingredients without percentages.
Sulfated ash, KV40, Mg, B, S and pour point not printed.

2026-10-17: TBN, KV100, density, Ca, Zn filled from the Richful official product page https://www.richful.com/catalogueDetail.html?id=112 (NOT from the datasheet); the page agrees with DL2-15451.pdf and with the file's existing P, Mo, N.
